page.overview:
What is Resistance?

The Resistance was a military resistance movement that opposed the First Order, a neo-Imperialist military junta. The Resistance was a small, private military force that emerged as a unauthorized splinter group from the New Republic Defense Force that believed that the First Order posed a serious threat to peace and democracy, and stood as a check against its ambitions of galactic conquest. However, the Galactic Senate did not believe them and regarded them having a fixation on the past. The Resistance fought the First Order after they launched a preemptive strike on the New Republic and subsequently occupied large swathes of the galaxy. Yet despite their initial stand alone, the freedom fighters of the Resistance inspired rebellion.

While Leia Organa was still a senator, she was sidelined from the Senate following a scandal that revealed her father to be the reviled Darth Vader. Following this, the Resistance was founded by Organa to keep a vigil over the New Republic against the backdrop of the First Order which had seceded from the New Republic, precipitating a return of fascism and militarism that claimed to be a successor of the Galactic Empire in all but name.

Organa as general recruited veterans of the Galactic Civil War, like Admiral Gial Ackbar and other New Republic military personnel like New Republic officer Poe Dameron, while many others joined the Resistance as officers, soldiers, pilots, and in other role who shared Organa view of the unknown threats the New Republic faced. The Resistance initially sought to obtain evidence of illegal military activities of the emerging First Order and report this to the Senate during Cold War amid rising tensions between the New Republic and First Order. Due to this, the Resistance was quietly tolerated by them, with some in the Senate supporting and even funding them in secret as the Resistance pursued evidence that the First Order was violating the Galactic Concordance from unknown space.

However, the Resistance would oppose the First Order in open warfare when they moved in to seize military control of the galaxy in 34 ABY. With the help of the last Jedi, Luke Skywalker, and his apprentice Rey, the Resistance escaped the First Order's siege at Crait and lived to fight another day. When Darth Sidious, publicly known as Emperor Palpatine, revealed himself to be resurrected and bolstered by the Sith Eternal's armada of planet-destroying warships, the Final Order, the Resistance invaded the ancient Sith redoubt at the Battle of Exegol. Together with a fleet assembled to reinforce them, the Resistance defeated the Sith Eternal's forces at Exegol. Meanwhile, Rey sacrificed herself to destroy the Sith Lord, though she was resurrected by Ben Solo, who gave his life force to save hers. The victory of the Resistance sparked an uprising against the First Order, whose military rule crumbled under a series of attacks.
